column1: # Active Tret and Laurel dialogue missing from prior Ashfall passes.

column3: Those voices... were mine?\nWhat have I done?{end_wait}
You stopped my fury...\nwithout killing me?{end_wait}
Forgive me, Kolima...\nPlease, let them live.{end_wait}
Those people had families.\nI took that from them.{end_wait}
The Water of Hermes\nsoaks into Tret's roots.{end_wait}
It's reaching my roots...\nThe pain is easing.{end_wait}
Please free Kolima.\nThe villagers are\nstill waiting.{end_wait}
Yes. I know what\nI have to do.{end_wait}
Who has come so far\ninto these dying woods?{end_wait}
